queries.q: Can you build me a PowerPoint deck for tomorrow's board meeting on Q3 results?
I have a content brief for next week's customer QBR and need a polished slide deck out of it.
I keep rewriting these updates as a doc but the board keeps asking for something they can flip through together in the room.
queries.notes: Intent-only, no artifact keyword; the request for something to flip through together signals slides over a written doc.

queries.q: We need slides for the all-hands covering what shipped this quarter and what's next.
Generate a pptx from these talking points, it should open with a headline stat and close with next steps.
I need our product review deck exported as a PDF so the exec team can review it offline before the meeting.
queries.notes: PDF export from a deck is explicitly in scope per the skill's When to Use list.

queries.q: Put together the slides for my product review with the design team tomorrow morning.
I'm presenting to the board next week and need something that actually looks professional, not a wall of text in a doc.
queries.notes: Intent-only, situation described with no deck or slide keyword at all.

queries.q: Take these messy meeting notes and turn them into something I can click through with the team instead of reading off a page.
queries.notes: Intent-only phrasing; click through implies slide navigation without naming the artifact.

queries.q: We're pitching investors next month; can you put together the deck from our updated positioning content?
I just need a quick flowchart of our incident escalation process to drop into the engineering runbook, nothing fancy.
queries.notes: A standalone diagram for a doc, not a slide deck; explicitly the mermaid skill's territory.

queries.q: I have one PRD and need consistent versions of it pitched to engineering, sales, and our exec sponsor without the framing drifting.
queries.notes: Fan-out to multiple audiences from one master source is the briefings skill's signature use, not a deck.

queries.q: The roadmap review just wrapped; can you write up what we decided so the teams who couldn't join are caught up?
queries.notes: Async written update of meeting outcomes for non-attendees, not a presentation.

queries.q: Can you update the numbers on our existing Q2 board deck with the latest figures?
queries.notes: Editing an existing PowerPoint file is explicitly out of scope; this skill only creates new decks from scratch.

queries.q: Build me an interactive web presentation with clickable sections for our product tour.
queries.notes: Interactive HTML presentation is explicitly excluded; this skill produces .pptx, not web output.

queries.q: I need a dashboard that visualizes our funnel conversion data across cohorts.
queries.notes: Complex data visualization is explicitly out of scope; the skill defers to dedicated charting tools.

queries.q: Before we build anything, I need a one-page overview pitching our proposed approach and the trade-offs we considered.
queries.notes: A one-page written pitch of approach and trade-offs, not slides.

queries.q: Why does my Next.js build fail with a module resolution error?
Draft the OKRs for our platform team for next quarter.
Can you help me plan the catering and seating chart for our team offsite?
